Binary-tree additions 11–20 were checked against linked LeetCode statements on 2026-09-12; their per-problem verifiedOn overrides the original snapshot date. Monotonic-stack guide additions checked on 2026-09-23; problem 42 intentionally also appears in 03 as a two-pointer exercise. Four standalone monotonic-stack template exercises are recorded separately in templates; they have no LeetCode IDs or difficulty ratings. The six Intervals selections at 21 follow the user screenshot; four free statements and both meeting-room Premium gates checked on 2026-10-09. Meeting-room difficulty follows the screenshot. Four problems intentionally repeat earlier sections.
